preview_en:
Fresh from their first win of the Ligue 1 season, Auxerre will look to claim another three points against a Brest side who remain a difficult outfit to predict.

Match News and Current Form

An all-important 1-0 victory over Nice last time out got Auxerre’s Ligue 1 campaign up and running at the fourth time of asking after a three-match losing run prior had left them floundering at the bottom of the early table. Following that up is far from guaranteed for a side bidding for successive clean sheets in league action for the first time since February, but playing at home could well play to their advantage. Auxerre have won three of the last four Ligue 1 games they hosted (L1), as many as they had in their previous 14 (D4, L7), and manager Will Still winning his last two personal H2Hs with Brest is another positive omen they can point towards here.

Brest may have fallen to a 1-0 defeat against PSG last time out, but a highly-competitive display should offer plenty of confidence as they move forward in their European quest. Five points from their opening four games serves as a respectable start so far, and they’re afforded a great opportunity to build on that here by posting consecutive away Ligue 1 wins for the first time since February 2025 after beating Le Havre in their last road trip. Defensive improvements are still desperately needed for the visitors though, as they remain without a clean sheet across their last 13 league games - the longest such run among current French top-flight sides pre-round.

Head-to-Head History

Auxerre have lost just two of their 14 Ligue 1 home games against Brest (W9, D3), winning each of the prior two 3-0.

Hot Stats and Streaks

Auxerre have averaged 5.4 corners per game across their 19 home league matches since the start of last season.

Auxerre have scored in each of their last nine Ligue 1 fixtures.

Five of Brest’s last six league games have seen both teams score.

Brest have accumulated 27 shots on target in Ligue 1 this season - the second most ahead of the round.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Auxerre’s Danny Namaso scored in his only prior H2H, while four of his last seven club goals have served as match openers. Ludovic Ajorque has netted in each of his last two H2Hs, and another goal here could hint at a positive result given Brest have lost on just one of his last 12 goalscoring appearances (W8, D3).

Auxerre remain without a handful of long-term absentees, while Brest are without the trio of Mama Baldé , Noah Edjouma and Mamady Diambou here.

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.

Betting Analysis

Given their strong H2H form and on the back of their first victory of the season last weekend, Auxerre to win seems to be priced attractively.

Author: Nathan Evans
